text:
Sam (AE): Kicking off POC with FinLedger. Need alignment on scope, success criteria, and model fit (context length + tool calling). Also pricing and timeline. @Priya can you own presales?
Priya (Solutions): I got this. They need PDF ingestion + in-chat tool calls to fetch account details. They prefer 32k context but are open to chunking.
Marco (ML Eng): For PDF Q&A, embedding + semantic search over chunks is robust. If they require stepwise tool calls we should benchmark tool-call latency on Dedicated.
Sam (AE): They asked for a ballpark for a 3-month POC: ~50k tokens/day, 100k embeddings. Any rough numbers?
Priya (Solutions): Quick back-of-envelope: hosted API + embeddings is higher unit cost but no commit. Dedicated lowers per-token but requires reserved capacity. I'll model both scenarios.
Elaine (Security): Security questionnaire arrived. Main concerns: data retention, KMS/HSM integration, audit logs, SOC2 text, and data residency (no inference outside VPC).
Sam (AE): Can Redwood Private run in their VPC/on-prem?
Marco (ML Eng): Yes. Private supports customer VPC or on-prem. We'll provide integration notes for KMS and retention settings. Elaine, can you draft responses?
Elaine (Security): On it. Also they want confirmation embeddings aren't stored beyond cache TTL. We'll provide a config and an attestation for the POC.
Priya (Solutions): Proposed POC success metrics: 1) P95 tool-call latency < 800ms, 2) reranker improves top-1 relevance by >=12% on our eval, 3) PDF Q&A end-to-end F1 >= 0.78. Agree?
Marco (ML Eng): Sounds reasonable. Rerank approach: dense 1536-d embeddings + FAISS candidate generation, then a lightweight cross-encoder for rerank. We'll run offline sims.
Sam (AE): Timeline suggestion: 2w infra + ingestion, 2w eval/tuning, 2w user testing = 6 weeks. Customer wants faster if possible.
Priya (Solutions): We can offer an MVE: deliver ingestion + baseline eval in 2w, so decision point is earlier.
Marco (ML Eng): Model options for 32k needs: 1) native 32k context model (higher cost, toolcall support varies), 2) 16k model + chunking + retrieval (cheaper, extra infra), 3) quantized 32k on Dedicated (lower cost per-token but Dedicated setup). I'll tabulate latency/cost tradeoffs.
Sam (AE): Please list recommended models and tradeoffs in the doc.
Priya (Solutions): For embeddings/indexing plan: propose 1536-d embeddings, FAISS HNSW for recall, periodic index rebuild, and a cross-encoder with 3-5 calibration queries.
Marco (ML Eng): Starter eval prompts I'll add. Example PDF Q&A prompt: 
``
User: "Find payment terms for invoice #1234 in the contract PDF."
System: "Return clause text and page, or ask clarifying question if ambiguous."
```
Priya (Solutions): Rerank eval sample: 
``
Query: "What are late payment fees?"
Gold: ["Section 7.2 Late fees: 1.5%/month", "Section 9 exceptions"]
Metrics: MRR@5, top-1 accuracy, precision@3
```
Elaine (Security): Legal also asked if we train on customer data. For POC we must confirm no training on PII and provide a non-training clause in the contract. We'll provide a technical note describing data pipeline isolation.
Marco (ML Eng): I'll provide a perf test script for tool-call latency on Dedicated (example cmd: `python perf_test.py --model redwood-32k --batch 1 --calls 100`).
Sam (AE): Action items: Priya - pricing scenarios + MVE plan by EOD Thurs. Marco - starter evals, model tradeoffs, latency numbers by Thurs. Elaine - security Q responses + KMS docs by Fri. I'll schedule a 30m sync with the customer after these docs.
Priya (Solutions): Uploading draft pricing + MVE plan now. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/finledger/poc-plan
DevBot: Reminder - attach sensitive docs to secure share: https://files.redwood.ai/safe-share
Sam (AE): Great. Reconvene Thurs 11am PT. :thumbsup:
